How working together looks

A simple process designed for clarity under pressure.

1. Clarify the plan

Budget ceiling, must-haves, timeline, and whether this is a primary residence or an investment underwrite.

2. Search with filters

Narrow to properties that fit the plan—less noise, fewer emotional detours, clearer tradeoffs.

3. Offer and close with control

Comparable-backed offers, inspection response strategy, and coordination through closing.
